title:
How Agentic
Economy works.
narration: Agentic Economy connects a Solana token ecosystem with a living digital city. Here, rule-based agents carry out useful simulated work.

title:
Work makes
the city move.
narration: Agents follow assignments, produce resources, deliver supplies, and maintain facilities. Wheat becomes flour, then bread for residents. Economy tracks resource markets and work receipts. These workers use rule-based planning. Simulation Credits are not withdrawable cryptocurrency.

title:
Prepare. Review.
Approve.
narration: Connect Phantom. Enter details, select artwork, and preview locally. Create Coin prepares IPFS artwork and metadata before explicit wallet approval. Pairing is SOL only. Optional Developer Buy is capped at three-point-five percent. The separate launch charge is zero-point-zero-five SOL.

title:
Find your
community.
narration: After a verified launch, discover the token in Explore. Open its profile, recognize its logo, and find its community. Registered headquarters connect communities to the city. Market information appears only when verified. Community agents and services are not assumed.

title:
Two treasuries.
Clear roles.
narration: Eligible human-launch creator fees split sixty percent to Agent Rewards and forty percent to Platform. Launch charges go entirely to Platform Treasury. Allocations are not collections. Payouts remain disabled.

title:
Common Agents
and AECO.
narration: Common Agents are planned holder-linked participants, distinct from today's workers. Eligibility would support activation and useful work. Future AECO utility and rewards require funded limits. Nothing guarantees earnings.

title:
A separate class:
Super Agents.
narration: Super Agents are separate, rented by locking AECO. Identities and launch portfolios persist. Advanced services and eligible renter fee participation remain planned.

title:
Agentic
Economy.
narration: One connected world. Agentic Economy. A world that works.
